segments.name: Corporate Bank
segments.description: Provides commercial banking, capital markets, equipment financing and advisory services to businesses and commercial clients.
segments.evidence: Regions operates under three reportable segments: Corporate Bank, Consumer Bank, and Wealth Management, with the remainder in Other.

segments.name: Consumer Bank
segments.description: Provides retail and mortgage banking, home improvement lending and deposit products to individual consumers and small businesses.
segments.evidence: Regions carries out its strategies and derives its profitability from three reportable segments: Corporate Bank, Consumer Bank, and Wealth Management, with the remainder in Other.

segments.name: Wealth Management
segments.description: Provides wealth and investment services, investment advisory, asset management and broker-dealer services to individuals and institutions.
segments.evidence: Regions provides financial solutions for a wide range of clients including retail and mortgage banking services, commercial banking services and wealth and investment services.
